provenance.prompt: A person is sitting on a chair, relaxed, with both feet on the floor. The person slowly leans forward, rests their elbows on their knees, then returns to sitting upright. The person stays seated in place throughout.

A person stands facing a closed door. The person reaches forward with their right hand, grasps the door handle at waist height, turns the handle, and pulls the door open while taking two small steps backward. The person releases the handle and stands upright. Natural full body motion, feet stepping on the floor.
